character.description: A cuter version of the existing Unity B companion: a tiny olive moss-green living creature, rounded soft body, small leaf-like head tufts, stubby legs, short tail, wide gentle dark eyes, timid first-journey companion energy. Preserve the current B identity, 3/4 view, muted earthy palette, and readable 1px dark outline. Cute proportion correction: make the face/head mass slightly smaller and less mascot-like than the previous cute candidate, while making the eyes larger relative to the face by about 1-2 logical pixels. Keep the body compact and creature-like. Do not add scarf, bag, clothing, props, human accessories, eyebrows, mouth detail, or new markings.

idle.action: subtle breathing, tiny blink, shy attentive bounce; keep feet mostly planted and do not change identity; keep head/face mass small while the larger eyes carry the cute read

walk.action: tiny soft companion walk with short steps, slight body bob, tail and leaf tufts following the motion; no running or exaggerated comedy; keep head/face mass small while the larger eyes carry the cute read
